en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal lined with historic brick and stone buildings in Bruges. On the left is a tree‑lined quay with a few pedestrians, while on the right and in the distance stand ornate gabled facades reflected in the still water. A small arched bridge crosses the canal in the background. Handwritten ink notes and a date appear across the sky area of the image. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as the quay of Marble Workers and the Palace of the Franc.
